items.title: v2.1.300
items.summary: What's changed Added virtualText to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt Added cache_creation_5m_tokens and cache_creation_1h_tokens to the OpenTelemetry api_request event, splitting cache writes by lifetime Added $.ui.view({ agentId }) for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and $.ui.view({}) goes back Added a dir prop on a mod's Text for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right Added /advisor on Claude Platform on AWS; no adv

items.title: v2.1.299
items.summary: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS environment variable: Claude gets the paths of @ file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all Added CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; "idleCompaction": false in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later Added $.prompt.media so a prompt.submit hook of a mod inst

items.summary: What's changed Added a code key to the Claude apps gateway's managed.policies[] : the same settings as cli , also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside desktop , it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode Added autoCompactWindow to subagent frontmatter and --agents definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window Added CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs Added CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when ret

items.title: v2.1.295
items.summary: What's changed Added onFailure: "block" for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done Added quoted text to the /copy picker, so a drafted message copies without its > markers Added a warning to claude plugin install , enable , disable and marketplace add when the settings file they write to does not load Added a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that

items.title: v2.1.294
items.summary: What's changed Fixed prompt and agent hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block Improved how prompt hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early

items.title: v2.1.293
